props.text: This existing template retains its authored size.
Start the next document your way
Project settings stores starting canvas sizes and grid spacing. This existing screen stays 1100 × 680 even though the next screen starts at 1400 × 900.
Add a screen and a template, then inspect their dimensions: 1400 × 900 and 700 × 450. Undo each creation to return to this workshop. Existing resources are not resized.
Open Project settings → Canvas authoring defaults. Change the sizes, cancel once, then apply a valid change. Save the project and reopen it to use its saved grid default.
Synthetic workshop · No external connections · Defaults are portable project data, not a runtime layout mode
